source: Matrix multiplication is a useful architectural example because high-performance implementations deliberately mirror the ZXNAME0000XZ hierarchy. ZXNAME0001XZ describes ZXNAME0002XZ as a hierarchy of tiles: devicewide work is decomposed into thread-block tiles, then warp/warpgroup tiles, then thread or matrixinstruction fragments.[11]
zh: 矩阵乘法是一个有用的架构示例，因为高性能实现有意镜像 ZXNAME0000XZ 层次结构。 ZXNAME0001XZ 将 ZXNAME0002XZ 描述为块的层次结构：设备范围的工作被分解为线程块块，然后是扭曲/扭曲组块，然后是线程或矩阵指令片段。 [11]
